title: Stick To
subtitle: 「遵守／堅持／不偏離」，究竟是哪一種 stick to？
description: 「遵守／堅持／不偏離」，究竟是哪一種 stick to？

words.note: 較正式，常用於規則、原則、標準、計劃或方法，表示嚴格遵守或不偏離。
words.example: All staff must adhere to the safety procedures.
words.exampleZh: 所有員工都必須遵守安全程序。

exercises.original: All employees must stick to the company's data-security rules.
exercises.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的資料安全規則。

options.explanation: ignore = 和必須遵守的意思相反。
change = 員工不是要修改規則。
adhere to = 公司正式規則 + must 明確支持較正式的 adhere to。
break = 表示違反規則。
stay with = 可表示繼續某選擇，但正式規則語境不如 adhere to 精確。
persist with = 強調持續做某事，不是合規本身。

exercises.original: Researchers should stick to the agreed ethical standards.
exercises.zh: 研究人員應遵守已協定的倫理標準。

options.explanation: follow loosely = loosely 會削弱標準的約束性。
change = 不是修改標準。
ignore = 相反。
adhere to = ethical standards 常與 adhere to 搭配，表示不偏離既定規範。
hold to a route = 不合 ethical standards。
stay on = 不自然搭配 standards。

exercises.original: The supplier failed to stick to the quality requirements in the contract.
exercises.zh: 供應商未能遵守合約中的品質要求。

options.explanation: break away from = 不是脫離組織或關係。
ignore completely = 語義過強，原句只說 failed to comply consistently。
change = 不是修改 requirements。
stay with = 不如 adhere to 表達合約要求。
adhere to = 合約 requirements 的正式遵守語境適合 adhere to。
persist with = 不合。

words.note: 表示按照原定路線、時間、計劃、主題或規則行事；比 adhere to 較日常。
words.example: Please keep to the agreed schedule.
words.exampleZh: 請按照已協定的時間表行事。

exercises.original: Please stick to the timetable so that the meeting ends on time.
exercises.zh: 請按照時間表進行，讓會議可以準時結束。
exercises.upgrade: keep to · 遵守；按照；不偏離

options.explanation: ignore = 相反。
change = 不是要改時間表。
break = 通常不說 break a timetable。
keep to = 日常地表示按時間表行事，keep to the timetable 很自然。
comply with = 語法可行但對普通 timetable 過於正式。
conform to = 可理解，但不如 keep to 自然。

exercises.original: Try to stick to the main topic during the discussion.
exercises.zh: 討論期間盡量不要偏離主要主題。
exercises.upgrade: keep to · 遵守；按照；不偏離

options.explanation: change = 不是改題。
ignore = 不是忽略主題。
persist with = 會偏向即使困難仍繼續，不是不要離題。
comply with = topic 不是 formal regulation。
keep to = keep to the topic 是表示不離題的常見搭配。
abide by = 不自然搭配 topic。

exercises.original: We need to stick to the budget this month.
exercises.zh: 我們這個月需要按照預算開支。
exercises.upgrade: keep to · 遵守；按照；不偏離

options.explanation: break = 可以說 break the budget 但不自然。
ignore = 相反。
change = 不是要修改 budget。
observe = 可正式，但日常財務語境不如 keep to。
hold to = 較偏立場或承諾。
keep to = 控制支出不超出 budget 時，keep to the budget 很自然。

words.note: 最常見的替換之一，表示按照規則、指示、程序、建議或路線行事。
words.example: Follow the instructions carefully before starting the machine.
words.exampleZh: 啟動機器前請仔細按照指示。

exercises.original: Stick to the instructions on the screen.
exercises.zh: 按照螢幕上的指示操作。

options.explanation: ignore = 相反。
change = 不是改寫 instructions。
break = 不自然搭配 instructions。
stay with = 不如 follow 表達逐步照做。
follow = instructions 最自然搭配 follow。
persist with = 不是強調困難中堅持。

exercises.original: Drivers should stick to the signs and directions provided by staff.
exercises.zh: 駕駛者應按照職員提供的標誌和指示行事。

options.explanation: hold to = 不自然搭配 signs。
ignore = 相反。
change = 不合。
persist with = 不合。
stay on = 缺少合適補語。
follow = signs and directions 是典型 follow 的對象。

exercises.original: If you stick to the recipe, the cake should turn out well.
exercises.zh: 如果你按照食譜做，蛋糕應該會成功。

options.explanation: follow = recipe 表示逐步指引，因此 follow the recipe 最自然。
comply with = 對家庭烹飪過於正式。
observe = 也偏正式。
change = 不是修改食譜。
ignore = 相反。
hold to = 不如 follow 自然。

words.note: 較正式，表示按照法律、規例、要求或正式指令行事；強調合規。
words.example: The company must comply with environmental regulations.
words.exampleZh: 公司必須遵守環境規例。

exercises.original: The company must stick to all workplace-safety regulations.
exercises.zh: 公司必須遵守所有工作場所安全規例。

options.explanation: stay with = 不如 comply with 表達法律合規。
persist with = 不合。
ignore = 相反。
change = 不是修改 regulations。
keep to casually = 語氣過於日常。
comply with = 正式法律／監管語境中，comply with regulations 是標準搭配。

exercises.original: Manufacturers are required to stick to the new labelling rules.
exercises.zh: 製造商被要求遵守新的標籤規則。

options.explanation: comply with = are required to + rules 明確是 formal compliance。
hold to = 較偏承諾或立場。
stay on = 不合。
persist with = 不表示法規合規。
change = 相反於已同意的條款。
ignore = 相反。

exercises.original: The building must stick to fire-safety standards before it can open.
exercises.zh: 大樓在開放前必須符合消防安全標準。

options.explanation: follow = 建築物本身較少說 follow standards。
comply with = 建築物是否符合正式標準，comply with 最精確。
stay with = 不合。
persist with = 不合。
ignore = 相反。
break = 相反。

words.note: 正式但常見，表示接受並遵守法律、規則、協議或決定。
words.example: Members are expected to abide by the club rules.

exercises.original: Members must stick to the rules of the association.
exercises.zh: 會員必須遵守協會規則。

options.explanation: abide by = 會員遵守 organisation rules 時，abide by 很自然。
change = 不是修改 rules。
ignore = 相反。
break = 相反。
stay on = 不合。
persist with = 不合。

exercises.original: Both sides agreed to stick to the terms of the settlement.
exercises.zh: 雙方同意遵守和解條款。

options.explanation: follow casually = settlement terms 是正式承諾，不宜弱化。
abide by = terms of settlement 是典型 abide by 對象。
change = 相反於已同意的條款。
ignore = 相反。
stay with = 可表示維持方案，但不如 abide by 強調遵守。
stay on = 不合。

exercises.original: Players are expected to stick to the rules of the competition.
exercises.zh: 參賽者應遵守比賽規則。

options.explanation: ignore = 相反。
change = 不是改規則。
abide by = 正式規則和競賽規範可自然用 abide by。
break = 相反。
detach from = 完全不合。
persist with = 不合。

words.note: 較正式，表示遵守法律、規則、慣例或程序；常見於 official / legal contexts。
words.example: Visitors must observe all posted safety rules.
words.exampleZh: 訪客必須遵守所有張貼的安全規則。

exercises.original: Visitors must stick to all safety rules in the laboratory.
exercises.zh: 訪客必須遵守實驗室所有安全規則。

options.explanation: ignore = 相反。
observe = 正式場所中遵守 safety rules 可用 observe。
change = 不是改 safety rules。
persist with = 不合。
stay with = 不如 observe 正式。
break = 相反。

exercises.original: All participants are expected to stick to the code of conduct.
exercises.zh: 所有參加者都應遵守行為守則。

options.explanation: change = 不是修改守則。
ignore = 相反。
observe = observe a code 是較正式的遵守用法。
stay on = 不合。
persist with = 不合。
follow a route = 語義不對。

exercises.original: Please stick to the local customs when visiting the temple.
exercises.zh: 參觀寺廟時請遵守當地習俗。

options.explanation: break = 和尊重 customs 相反。
ignore = 相反。
change = 不合。
observe = 對 customs / traditions 的遵守常用 observe。
comply with = 對 customs 過於法律化。
stay with = 不如 observe 自然。

words.note: 表示行為、產品、文件或做法符合某個標準、規範或既定模式；不一定完全等於一般 stick to。
words.example: The design must conform to the required technical standard.
words.exampleZh: 設計必須符合所要求的技術標準。

exercises.original: The product must stick to the required safety standard.
exercises.zh: 產品必須符合所要求的安全標準。

options.explanation: follow = 產品本身不會主動 follow instructions。
stay with = 不合產品合規。
conform to = 產品與標準的符合關係最自然用 conform to。
persist with = 不合。
ignore = 相反。
hold to = 不自然。

exercises.original: All documents should stick to the approved format.
exercises.zh: 所有文件都應符合已批准的格式。

options.explanation: abide by = 較常用於人遵守規則。
stay with = 不如 conform to 表達格式符合。
persist with = 不合。
conform to = 文件格式符合既定樣式時，conform to 最精確。
change = 相反。
ignore = 相反。

exercises.original: The new design sticks to industry standards.
exercises.zh: 新設計符合行業標準。

options.explanation: follow = 可理解，但對 design/standards conform to 更正式精確。
stay on = 不合。
persist with = 不合。
hold to = 較偏人或機構堅守立場。
conform to = 設計和 industry standards 的相符關係是 conform to 的典型語境。
ignore = 相反。

words.note: 當 stick to 表示繼續使用原本的選擇、計劃、方法或決定，而不是中途改變時很自然。
words.example: We decided to stay with the original plan.
words.exampleZh: 我們決定繼續採用原本的計劃。

exercises.original: We decided to stick to the original plan despite the new suggestion.
exercises.zh: 即使有新建議，我們仍決定沿用原本計劃。
exercises.upgrade: stay with · 繼續採用；不改變

options.explanation: comply with = 原本計劃不是法規。
observe = 不自然搭配 personal/project choice。
abide by = 語氣過於規範化。
stay with = 面對替代方案仍維持原本選擇，stay with 最自然。
change = 與句意相反。
ignore = 不是忽略 plan，而是繼續使用它。

exercises.original: For now, let's stick to the current supplier.
exercises.zh: 暫時我們繼續使用目前的供應商。
exercises.upgrade: stay with · 繼續採用；不改變

options.explanation: follow = supplier 不是指示。
comply with = 不合。
observe = 不合。
change = 與句意相反。
stay with = 繼續保留原有供應商而不更換，stay with 很自然。
abide by = 不合。

exercises.original: She chose to stick to the same method for another month.
exercises.zh: 她選擇再沿用同一方法一個月。
exercises.upgrade: stay with · 繼續採用；不改變

options.explanation: comply with = method 不是法律要求。
observe = 不合。
break = 相反。
change = 相反。
abide by = 不自然。
stay with = 不改方法、繼續使用現有方案，stay with 最精確。

words.note: 表示即使遇到困難或成效未立即出現，仍繼續某個方法、計劃或行動；比一般 stick to 更強調毅力。
words.example: She persisted with the training programme despite slow progress.
words.exampleZh: 即使進展緩慢，她仍堅持這個訓練計劃。

exercises.original: He stuck to the treatment even though improvement was slow.
exercises.zh: 即使改善緩慢，他仍堅持接受這項治療。
exercises.upgrade: persist with · 堅持繼續；持續採用

options.explanation: stay on = 不完整且不自然。
comply with = 不是合規語境。
observe = 不合。
change = 與 continued treatment 相反。
persist with = even though improvement was slow 強調困難中仍持續，最適合 persist with。
ignore = 不合。

exercises.original: The team stuck to the new approach despite several early setbacks.
exercises.zh: 儘管初期遭遇幾次挫折，團隊仍堅持新方法。
exercises.upgrade: persist with · 堅持繼續；持續採用

options.explanation: abide by = approach 不是規則。
comply with = 不合。
observe = 不合。
change = 與 despite setbacks 的堅持相反。
ignore = 不合。
persist with = despite setbacks 是 persistence 的直接線索。

exercises.original: She stuck to her rehabilitation exercises even when they were difficult.
exercises.zh: 即使復康運動很困難，她仍堅持做。
exercises.upgrade: persist with · 堅持繼續；持續採用

options.explanation: persist with = 困難中仍繼續 exercises，persist with 最精確。
conform to = 不是符合標準。
observe = 不合。
abide by = 不是規則。
change = 相反。
ignore = 相反。

words.note: 較正式，表示堅持某個立場、承諾、原則或協議，不輕易改變。
words.example: The committee held to its original decision.
words.exampleZh: 委員會堅持原來的決定。

exercises.original: The committee stuck to its original decision after reviewing the evidence.
exercises.zh: 委員會在審視證據後仍堅持原來決定。

options.explanation: comply with = decision 是自身立場，不是外部規例。
observe = 不合。
follow = 可 follow a decision in some contexts，但這裡更重點是堅持不改。
change = 相反。
ignore = 不合。
hold to = 審視後仍不改原決定，held to 很自然。

exercises.original: She stuck to her principles even under pressure.
exercises.zh: 即使承受壓力，她仍堅守自己的原則。

options.explanation: hold to = principles + under pressure 是 hold to 的典型語境。
comply with = principles 是個人信念，不是外部規例。
follow instructions = 不合。
change = 相反。
ignore = 相反。
stay on = 不合。

exercises.original: The company stuck to its promise to keep the factory open.
exercises.zh: 公司堅守保持工廠營運的承諾。

options.explanation: conform to = promise 不是技術標準。
hold to = 堅持承諾、不反悔可用 hold to a promise。
observe = 較少說 observe a promise。
stay on = 不合。
ignore = 相反。
change = 不合。

words.note: 當 stick to 指不偏離路線、任務、主題或進度時可用，常見於 stay on track / stay on topic / stay on schedule 等結構。
words.example: The team needs to stay on schedule to meet the deadline.
words.exampleZh: 團隊需要按進度行事，才能趕上期限。

exercises.original: We need to stick to schedule if we want to finish by Friday.
exercises.zh: 如果想在星期五前完成，我們需要按進度行事。
exercises.upgrade: stay on · 保持在；按……繼續

options.explanation: stay on = finish by Friday 明確關乎進度，因此 stay on schedule 最自然。
abide by = schedule 不是法律規則。
observe = 語氣不自然。
persist with = 雖有持續意思，但不直接表達按進度。
change = 會偏離原本時程。
ignore = 相反。

exercises.original: Please stick to the topic during the presentation.
exercises.zh: 簡報期間請不要離題。
exercises.upgrade: stay on · 保持在；按……繼續

options.explanation: comply with = topic 不是 formal regulation。
stay on = stay on topic 是表示不偏離主題的固定搭配。
observe = 不自然。
abide by = 不合。
change = 不是要換題。
persist with = 不如 stay on topic 精確。

exercises.original: The project is sticking to its planned timeline so far.
exercises.zh: 到目前為止，項目仍按原定時間線進行。
exercises.upgrade: stay on · 保持在；按……繼續

options.explanation: abiding by = project 不是人去遵守法律。
observing = 不自然。
stay on = 表示進度仍未偏離原定 timeline，staying on 很合適。
complying with = 可以說 schedule compliance，但此句較日常。
changing = 與保持原進度相反。
ignoring = 相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 違反與遵守方向相反 break a rule 表示違反規則；stick to a rule 表示遵守規則。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You stick to a rule when you obey it; you break it when you violate it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽略不等於遵循 ignore 表示不理會規則、建議或指示；與 stick to 的意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ignoring instructions is the opposite of following them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 改變不等於堅持 change 表示更換方法、計劃或決定；stick to 通常表示維持原來選擇。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If you stick to a plan, you do not change it without good reason.

falseSynonyms.zh: adhere 單獨通常不是此義的完整結構 adhere to 才表示遵守；單獨 adhere 常表示黏附。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A label adheres to a surface; a person adheres to a rule.

falseSynonyms.zh: follow 只在部分語境等同 stick to follow 很適合規則、指示和程序；但對『繼續原本選擇』而言，stay with 往往更精確。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You follow instructions, but you may stay with an original plan.

falseSynonyms.zh: 合規語氣較正式 comply with 常用於法律、規例和正式要求；日常計劃或個人選擇不一定適合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A company complies with regulations; a person may simply stick to a diet.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單獨 stick 與片語 stick to 不同 stick 可表示黏、插入，也可作名詞表示棍子；stick to 才常表示堅持或遵守。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Glue makes paper stick; people stick to a plan.

falseSynonyms.zh: persist 通常需要合適介詞或補語 persist with 表示堅持某做法；persist 單獨只表示持續存在或繼續。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She persisted with the method. The problem persisted for weeks.
